# form: # Spanish clitic pronouns (C13; teacher-editable). role: acc (direct object), dat (indirect object), refl (always
# reflexive or pronominal), any (accusative, dative or reflexive by context). The tokenizer splits these off verbs
# ("dámelo" -> da me lo, "siéntate" -> sienta te); the frame builder makes them arguments: a clitic of the verb's
# own person is reflexive (pronominal verb "irse" when phrasal_es_la.tsv has a "se" row), "le/les" the indirect
# object, "lo/la/los/las" the direct object, "me/te/nos/os" the indirect object when the verb already has a direct
# object or is a giving/telling verb, else the direct object. Our own list.
